text: Good evening, I'm looking after my grandson tonight while his mum and dad are away. He's 11 months old. He's had a temperature on and off today, it was 38.3 when I took it about an hour ago. I gave him the baby paracetamol his mum left, the right amount on the box, and honestly in between he's been his usual self, crawling about, playing with his blocks, drinking his milk fine and babbling away at me like nothing's wrong. Then it creeps up again and he goes a bit quieter until the next dose. I've probably got myself worked up over nothing and you've likely got far more serious calls than mine. It's just been a long time since mine were small and I don't want to get it wrong while he's in my care. Is there anything I should be doing differently, or anything I should be watching for overnight?
